Messages.Author: Kulaid
Messages.Body:
Question 1, Does Aching beauty stack? I assume it does, but haven't
read anything about it...

Question 2, if I mask between 2 toreadors that has aching beauty...
Does the blocking minion burn pool for blocking both toreadors... Or
just the masked toreador? I'm guessing it'll depends on when the mask
happen, during the block or right before it...

Question 3, if you have a vampire that has to make a mandatory action
before any other minion takes an action. Can you mask to a vampire
that doesn't have to do the mandatory action? (ie. somebody tries to
block the empty vampires hunt, mask it somebody that can pound the
blocker to dust? Or can't mask it at all? )

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Kulaid wrote:
>
> Question 1, Does Aching beauty stack? I assume it does, but haven't
> read anything about it...

Yes. All cards stack by default.

> Question 2, if I mask between 2 toreadors that has aching beauty...
> Does the blocking minion burn pool for blocking both toreadors... Or
> just the masked toreador? I'm guessing it'll depends on when the mask
> happen, during the block or right before it...

Assuming the mask is played after the block is successful, the former.
Google: "mask aching block author:LSJ"

> Question 3, if you have a vampire that has to make a mandatory action
> before any other minion takes an action. Can you mask to a vampire
> that doesn't have to do the mandatory action? (ie. somebody tries to
> block the empty vampires hunt, mask it somebody that can pound the
> blocker to dust? Or can't mask it at all? )

Yes.
